Asalamualaikum 1-Regarding playing carrom board in answer 3081 in english you mention its permissible and in answer 6850 in urdu you mention its makrooh tahreemi why does the answers conflict each other? 2-Is it permissible to play carrom board if a person obeys the laws of shariah and sell Carrom board to others? could you please give a answer which is certain. 19500 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 64146 Country: india Title: Regarding doing business of Digital printing of Hording,banner Question: I am providing services of advertisement agency which includes (printing of photographs of men, animals, other religious statues (devi, devtas) by way of digital boards, hoardings, banners and printing of flex papers. I approached some Ulama but I am not satisfied by their views. Please I seek your advice about this business. Is it halal or haram? Please understand the question and give detail explanation in view of Shariah. Answer ID: 64146 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 651/651/SD=08/1437) It is not lawful as per the Shariah to print the pictures of human beings, animals, devi devtas on digital board and printing flex paper. Hadiths sternly warns on making the pictures of living beings. Hence it is not lawful to provide service of advertisement agency that contains living beings. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
